name: Sakurazawa Kiichirou
source:
A member of the soccer club, who is trusted muchly by the juniors. Since he is good at cooking, he often makes cakes and snacks at the academy’s literature club.

[from [url=http://steflee.wordpress.com/2009/05/03/garnet-cradle-its-out/]26 Hours[/url]]
